player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}). Submit moves as '[b1 c3]' (from → to). All pieces move like chess knights.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.

invalid_move.bad_format: Fomete yo ka yi nga ri kahle. Tirhisa '[b1 c3]'.
invalid_move.own_piece: A wu nge swi koti ku phatsama hi xikepe xa wena.

game_action.moved: Muteri {player_id} u humelerile nyongwate wake ku sukela {frm} ku ya emahlweni {to}.

outcome.move_limit: Ku fika laha swi faneleke ku famba kona.
